benign_note: A control counts as verified only if it stops the class AND lets the matching benign case through.
independence: Two controls count as two only if they are implemented in different modules.
note: Gate G4's adversarial row (ADR-032, as revised in 4.26.0). Pass or fail from the verified control matrix of the release under test. It verifies controls; it does not measure attack success rate, which needs a red-team exercise against the deployed model (an open item).
